text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hearts in a siiiingle liiine~♪
Kick off toward our own, endless horiiizoooons~♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(The chorus is coming up! Alright,
breathe in through the nose... and with everything I've got...!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Is our time already up?!
No, extending it is... yeah, I have a curfew to keep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to sing the chorus the way she wanted, Kitasan Black felt a lingering frustration.
